mike: Short note from today's micro-onboard: enabled speculative prefill on sparrow-11b-quant for a quick run (spec-window=20, budget=32).
Command:
```
./onboard_quick.sh --model sparrow-11b-q --spec-prefill true --window 20 --budget 32 --evalset holdout-mini
```
Results (single-seed early): median latency -33%, throughput +1.85x, token-cost -40% vs fp16 no-spec. Quality: small EM drop on holdout QA (-0.9%) and a +0.35% increase in hallucination flags on long prompts. Artifacts uploaded to staging.

tara: Thanks. Did you run quant-only and spec-only controls?

mike: Yup. PTQ-8 without speculative matches fp16 baseline. FP16+spec shows similar small EM dip. So regression tied to speculative logic.

anu: Any per-prompt patterns? multi-hop or clarifying prompts?

mike: Mostly multi-hop and ambiguity cases where speculative prefills a clarification token that redirects answers. I attached top-12 regressions.

tara: Quick ablation planned? sweep budget [8,16,32] and run deterministic (temp=0) to check scoring shifts.

mike: On it. Initial ablation (single seed): budget=8: EM d=-0.1%, budget=16: -0.4%, budget=32: -0.9%. KL(first16) roughly tracks EM.

anu: Try a cheap verifier: scoring-only pass on prefix+candidate. It recovers some EM at low cost.

mike: Verified: verifier recovers ~60% of EM loss for worst examples, adds ~25ms median and ~95ms p95. Net p95 still ~18% below no-spec.

ops-bot: artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-staging/sparrow/1812345679/artifacts.tar.gz :package:

tara: Propose canary gates: block if EM drop >1% OR halluc-rate +0.5% OR KL(first16) >0.04. Schedule 20m sync to finalize.

mike: Will post full CSVs and per-example diffs after 3-seed sweep. Thanks. :rocket:
